title: Feature-flagged cohort SLO-driven validation for pinned model variants
creator: Ethan Rivera
description: Motivation: We need a repeatable, low-risk way to validate new model revisions that are pinned for customers. Existing approaches (simple traffic splits or shadowing) don't operationalize automated rollback when quality or latency regressions are detected across customer-specific pins. Goal: implement a feature-flag gated cohort experiment system that runs A/B-style and canary validations for pinned variants, evaluates both quality (prompt-set metrics) and runtime SLOs, and can trigger automated rollback or hold traffic based on configurable rules. This ticket covers the PM scope: acceptance criteria, rollout policy, guardrails, evaluation signals, and coordination with ENG/Design for implementation. Scope in this ticket: experiment definition UI patterns, default SLO thresholds and signal sets, integration points for console dashboards, and orchestration requirements for feature-flag gating (per-customer pins). Out of scope: low-level kernel scheduling or runtime batching changes (handled by ENG tickets).
acceptance_criteria: 1) Product can create a feature-flagged experiment attached to a model pin that allocates cohorts (0%, small cohorts, ramp to X%) with configurable duration and metrics. 2) Console displays cohort-level metrics (latency p95, token cost per request, eval precision/recall on designated prompt sets) and highlights regressions vs baseline. 3) Automated policy engine can mark a rollout as: continue, pause, or rollback based on user-configured rules (latency or quality breach) and send alerts. 4) Experiments are auditable with links to sample prompts, comparisons, and decision logs. 5) Documentation and a short runbook for SRE and customer success exist.
rollout_plan: Phase 1 (alpha, internal only): feature-flag gating with static cohorts for a subset of customers; 2-week duration; manual review + automated detectors that only alert. Phase 2 (beta): enable automated hold/rollback for latency regressions (p95 and error rate) with conservative thresholds; expand to 10% of pinned customers. Phase 3 (GA): enable automated rollback for combined signal (quality + latency) with customizable policies and per-customer overrides; enable UI templates for common policies. Ramp durations and cohort sizes are configurable in the Console; default policy suggested: 1% for 24h -> 5% for 24h -> 20% for 48h -> GA. Feature flags are reversible and logged for audit.
metrics: Primary metrics: latency p50/p95/p99, request error rate, tokens per request, token cost, eval-based quality delta on the pinned prompt-set (precision@k, hallucination rate), customer-facing error spikes. Secondary: model throughput, CPU/GPU utilization on Dedicated pools, false-positive rate for automated rollback. Success criteria: no customer-facing regression (customer-reported defects) during alpha; beta: automated rollback triggers fewer than 1 per 100 rollouts and reduces mean time to mitigation by 40%.
